May 30, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Putnam Investments Llc increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 6.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Putnam Investments Llc bought 41,172 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 707,134 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $32.35 million, up from 665,962 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Putnam Investments Llc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $188.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.57% or $0.74 during the last trading session, reaching $46.26. About 12.43 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 3.98% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.59% the S&P500.
Bangor Savings Bank increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 16.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC.
